name: Functional Analysis
description: The study of vector spaces endowed with a kind of limit-related structure and the linear functions defined on these spaces.

name: Harmonic Analysis
description: The branch of mathematics concerned with the representation of functions or signals as the superposition of basic waves.

name: Besov Space
description: A class of Banach spaces of generalized functions, used to measure smoothness of functions.

name: Littlewood-Paley Theory
description: A theoretical framework in Fourier analysis used to decompose functions into frequencies.

name: Geometric Measure Theory
description: The study of geometric properties of sets through measure theory, often used to analyze singularities in calculus of variations.

name: Hausdorff Dimension
description: A measure of roughness or fractal dimension, measuring the local size of a set taking into account distance between points.

name: Bounded Mean Oscillation
description: A class of functions in harmonic analysis that describes functions with bounded average variation, serving as a replacement for L infinity.

name: Partial Differential Equation
description: Equations that impose relations between the various partial derivatives of a multivariable function.
